concept: Lavender Dreams (Provence-style lavender fields, cottages, bees)
title: Lavender Dreams Coloring Book: Provence Lavender Fields, Stone Cottages, and Cozy Garden Scenes with Bold and Easy Designs for Adults
subtitle: 50 Relaxing Illustrations of French Countryside Lavender Bouquets, Honey Bees, Vintage Vases, and Charming Provence Villages for Stress Relief
description:
Escape to the sun-drenched lavender fields of Provence with this enchanting adult coloring book. Featuring 50 unique, hand-crafted illustrations of rolling lavender rows, charming stone cottages, busy honey bees, and cozy French countryside scenes.

Each page is designed with bold, clean outlines and large open shapes perfect for colored pencils, gel pens, or markers. Whether you love fragrant lavender bouquets in vintage vases, quaint Provence village streets, or peaceful garden gates draped in purple blooms, every scene invites you to relax, unwind, and create something beautiful.

Inside you will find:

  • Sweeping lavender fields with rolling Provencal hills and cypress trees
  • Lavender bouquets in vintage pitchers, wicker baskets, and rustic pots
  • Busy honey bees and butterflies dancing among the purple blooms
  • Charming stone cottages with lavender window boxes and wooden shutters
  • Garden gates, stone pathways, and cobblestone village streets
  • Harvest scenes with lavender bundles, drying racks, and market stalls
  • Cozy interiors with lavender sachets, herbal teas, and countryside views

Perfect for lavender lovers, Francophiles, and anyone seeking a peaceful Provencal creative escape. Makes a wonderful gift for birthdays, holidays, or any day that needs a touch of calm.

cover_prompt: Full-color illustration of a warm, dreamy Provence lavender field scene in rich cottagecore aesthetic. SQUARE format (1:1 aspect ratio). Endless rows of vibrant purple lavender stretching toward a golden horizon under a soft warm sky with peach and amber tones. The lavender rows are lush and vivid in deep purples, soft lilacs, and rich violet hues. A rustic stone cottage with blue wooden shutters and a terracotta tile roof sits nestled among the fields in the midground. In the foreground, a vintage wicker basket overflowing with freshly cut lavender bundles sits at the edge of a row, beside a pair of garden shears and a straw sun hat. Several honey bees hover among the blooms and a pale blue butterfly rests on a lavender stem. Tall cypress trees frame the scene on one side. Warm golden hour sunlight bathes the entire scene in a soft amber-purple haze. Rich warm color palette with deep purples, lavender blues, golden yellows, warm terracotta, and sage greens. Premium illustrated book cover aesthetic, rich detail, inviting and serene. DO NOT include any text, titles, or words in the image.
